title: Null Completeness and Directional Rigidity in Bianchi I Spacetimes
summary: In Einstein gravity, every null geodesic of a non-static Bianchi I spacetime satisfying the null energy condition is incomplete in at least one direction within the Bianchi I region. We prove a stronger directional rigidity theorem: a single null geodesic complete in both affine directions forces staticity if the null curvature is nonnegative along it and, at each time, in one transverse null direction.
